decisions.reason: The firm has invested in the module and publicly committed to the modular platform, with no reported disappointing results, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
As a core measurement module replacing a previous generation, it represents sunk investment and public commitment, making dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
The CAN bus module is central to the announced connectivity expansion and has received ongoing investment, so escalation of commitment implies keeping it.
The CO2 sensor module aligns with the firm's sensing portfolio and has visible commitment, so despite limited recent web archiving, escalation of commitment supports keeping it.
